messages:
customer_acct: Hey, production traffic started failing when we turned on structured_output=true. Parsers are throwing invalid JSON. Happening around 08:04 UTC. Correlation id 8f3b2a. Can you look?

anya_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact API response (body) and the request payload you used? Also which model did the call route to?

customer_acct: Payload was standard: {
  "input": "Summarize the order",
  "structured_output": true,
  "schema": { ... }
}
Response body looks like this (we log it raw):

HTTP 200
{
  "result": "{\\\"summary\\\": \\\"Delivered on 2026-03-17\\\", \\\"status\\\": \\\"ok\\\"}"
}

Parse error when unwrapping result (extra string quoting). Our JSON library fails. This started immediately after a hot-swap at ~08:02.

anya_support: Hmm, thanks. Did you see any 4xx/5xx or latency spikes as well?

customer_acct: Latency doubled for a bit, then fell back. No 5xx. Billing shows a small token spike for that window.

deploy-bot: automated message: model routing decision changed for tenant=acct-9012 at 2026-03-17T08:02:11Z — primary redwood-std-v3, fallback redwood-quant-v2 (quantized).

sam_engineer: tagging in. This looks like the classic "variant wrapper" problem when the quantized variant returns a prose wrapper instead of raw structured output. Can you grab the full response headers + correlation id?

customer_acct: Correlation id 8f3b2a in logs, headers: x-rw-request-id: 8f3b2a, x-model: redwood-quant-v2, x-latency-ms: 1200. Full body pasted above.

sam_engineer: Repro steps requested. Can you try this exact curl and paste results?

sam_engineer: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-std-v3","input":"Summarize the order","structured_output":true,"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}}}}'
```

customer_acct: Ran that with model redwood-std-v3 pinned and it returns clean JSON (no wrapper). When I change model to redwood-quant-v2 (the fallback) I get the wrapped string as above.

sam_engineer: OK confirmed repro locally with quant variant. Example malformed response we see: 

{
  "result": "{\\\"summary\\\": \\\"Delivered on 2026-03-17\\\", \\\"status\\\": \\\"ok\\\"}"
}

Which means structured_output layer expected an object but got a string containing escaped JSON — parser-level schema drift. Likely a model-side postprocessing prompt template differs.

anya_support: Next steps: pin customer to redwood-std-v3 until we push a fix and create an internal ticket to prevent the quantized variant from injecting wrappers. Can we also add a temporary smart-routing rule to avoid redwood-quant-v2 for structured_output requests?

sam_engineer: I'll add a per-tenant routing exception and open an engineering ticket. Need to know whether other tenants hit this. Kai, any SRE concerns?

kai_oncall: Saw a latency spike and increased tokens in that window for a few customers. No infra incidents, but routing churn caused extra inference ops. Recommend throttling routing changes during peak windows and add a smoke test for structured_output compatibility when promoting variants.

sam_engineer: Agreed. I'll draft a rollout guard that runs the schema conformance check: call with a canonical prompt + schema and assert the response is valid JSON and matches top-level type before switching traffic.

anya_support: Communicated to customer: we've pinned your traffic, created ticket RW-4678 (engineering), and added you to the beta for a stricter structured_output guard. Sorry for the trouble :disappointed:.

customer_acct: Thanks. For the ticket can you include repro steps, the curl command, headers, and the corrupted body? We need ETA because this blocks our parser ingestion.

sam_engineer: Adding everything to RW-4678 now. ETA for mitigation (routing pin + rule) is ~1 hour. Full fix (model prompt/template update + rollout test) ~3-5 days.

deploy-bot: automated message: routing override applied for tenant=acct-9012 at 2026-03-17T08:10:45Z — pinned model redwood-std-v3 until RW-4678 resolved.

kai_oncall: Also adding a billing note — we'll credit the token overage for the affected window. Finance notified.

anya_support: Closing loop with customer and will update RW-4678 with any further logs. If anyone finds other affected variants, ping here.

customer_acct: Appreciate the quick response. We'll validate on our side and report if anything else pops up.
